create_DatadogMetricsLogger: create a DatadogMetricsLogger instance to send LLM request metrics to Datadog
build_extract_tags: build a list of Datadog metric tags from a logging payload including env, service, model, and team tags
add_metrics_from_log: add latency and request count metric series to the Datadog queue from a standard logging payload
test_async_health_check: test the Datadog integration health by sending a test metric point to Datadog
run_async_log_success_event: run async_log_success_event to record successful LLM request metrics with status code 200
